Remark
[Continuity of the weak solution] ↗ def:weak-solution-hyperbolic-bvp ↗ thm:calculus-abstract-space 1. ch7:7.2.1-rem-2\group Hyperbolic PDE

Every weak solution satisfies $u\in C([0,T];L^2(U))$ and $u'\in C([0,T];H^{-1}(U))$, so both initial conditions are meaningful.
